baselines: three-bin VIX-percentile persistence with four-block shrinkage

features.description: Constant-maturity VX 30-to-60-day percentage slope as a decimal
features.name: curve_slope

features.description: VIX less trailing 21-session annualized SPY realized volatility
features.name: vrp

manifest.kill_rule: Every endpoint must beat the best baseline by max(0.0025 absolute, 2% relative), bootstrap P>=0.80, survive leave-one-positive-episode-out, balance positive/calm blocks, and have >=4 positive plus >=20 total OOS blocks.
manifest.name: risk_v2_stage3_persistence_gauntlet
manifest.preprocessing: fixed hard caps; train-fold 1st/99th winsorization; train-fold standardization; no interactions or feature selection

targets.spy_drawdown_5: Any SPY close at or below 95% of today's close in t+1 through t+H
targets.vix_above_25: Any VIX close strictly above 25 in t+1 through t+H

model_status.message: Fitted probabilities are withheld because at least one frozen endpoint failed the persistence gauntlet.
reasons: spy_drawdown_5 21d: beats_best_baseline, minimum_improvement, bootstrap_probability_at_least_0_80, leave_one_positive_episode_out, positive_and_calm_balance
